\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 320-323 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R328-first-pass-words-from-chapters-320-323}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an axe and a spade.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item famous, ordinary, dear, terrible, awesome
  \item spotted, fragrant, smelly, noisy, honest
  \item biryani, a chapati, a parotta, tapioca, a chutney
  \item a watermelon, spinach, a carrot, a cucumber, coriander
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Famous? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രശസ്തമായ}}, \emph{praśastamāya}.) Ordinary? (\textbf{\ml{സാധാരണ}}, \emph{sādhāraṇa}.) Dear? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട}}, \emph{priyappeṭṭa}.) Terrible? (\textbf{\ml{ഭയങ്കരമായ}}, \emph{bhayaṅkaramāya}.) Awesome? (\textbf{\ml{അടിപൊളി}}, \emph{aṭipoḷi}.) Spotted? (\textbf{\ml{പുള്ളിയുള്ള}}, \emph{puḷḷiyuḷḷa}.) Fragrant? (\textbf{\ml{സുഗന്ധമുള്ള}}, \emph{sugandhamuḷḷa}.) Smelly? (\textbf{\ml{നാറുന്ന}}, \emph{nāṟunna}.) Noisy? (\textbf{\ml{ബഹളമുള്ള}}, \emph{bahaḷamuḷḷa}.) Honest? (\textbf{\ml{സത്യസന്ധമായ}}, \emph{satyasandhamāya}.) Biryani? (\textbf{\ml{ബിരിയാണി}}, \emph{biriyāṇi}.) A chapati? (\textbf{\ml{ചപ്പാത്തി}}, \emph{cappātti}.) A parotta? (\textbf{\ml{പൊറോട്ട}}, \emph{poṟōṭṭa}.) Tapioca? (\textbf{\ml{കപ്പ}}, \emph{kappa}.) A chutney? (\textbf{\ml{ചമ്മന്തി}}, \emph{cammanti}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\ml{തണ്ണിമത്തൻ}}, \emph{taṇṇimattan}.) Spinach? (\textbf{\ml{ചീര}}, \emph{cīra}.) A carrot? (\textbf{\ml{കാരറ്റ്}}, \emph{kāraṟṟŭ}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\ml{വെള്ളരിക്ക}}, \emph{veḷḷarikka}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\ml{മല്ലി}}, \emph{malli}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 324-328 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R328-second-pass-words-from-chapters-324-328}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a document and a certificate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a document, a certificate, a passport, a visa, insurance
  \item a baby, a person, a woman, a man, a young man
  \item a fireworks display, Diwali, a puja, tradition, culture
  \item a sheep, a crocodile, a house lizard, a bee, a spider
  \item a bench, a shelf, a curtain, an axe, a spade
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A document? (\textbf{\ml{രേഖ}}, \emph{rēkha}.) A certificate? (\textbf{\ml{സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ്}}, \emph{sarṭṭiphikkaṟṟŭ}.) A passport? (\textbf{\ml{പാസ്പോർട്ട്}}, \emph{pāspōrṭṭŭ}.) A visa? (\textbf{\ml{വിസ}}, \emph{visa}.) Insurance? (\textbf{\ml{ഇൻഷുറൻസ്}}, \emph{inṣuṟansŭ}.) A baby? (\textbf{\ml{കുഞ്ഞ്}}, \emph{kuññŭ}.) A person? (\textbf{\ml{ആൾ}}, \emph{āḷ}.) A woman? (\textbf{\ml{സ്ത്രീ}}, \emph{strī}.) A man? (\textbf{\ml{പുരുഷൻ}}, \emph{puruṣan}.) A young man? (\textbf{\ml{ചെറുപ്പക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{ceṟuppakkāran}.) A fireworks display? (\textbf{\ml{വെടിക്കെട്ട്}}, \emph{veṭikkeṭṭŭ}.) Diwali? (\textbf{\ml{ദീപാവലി}}, \emph{dīpāvali}.) A puja? (\textbf{\ml{പൂജ}}, \emph{pūja}.) Tradition? (\textbf{\ml{പാരമ്പര്യം}}, \emph{pāramparyaṁ}.) Culture? (\textbf{\ml{സംസ്കാരം}}, \emph{saṁskāraṁ}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\ml{ചെമ്മരിയാട്}}, \emph{cemmariyāṭŭ}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\ml{മുതല}}, \emph{mutala}.) A house lizard? (\textbf{\ml{പല്ലി}}, \emph{palli}.) A bee? (\textbf{\ml{തേനീച്ച}}, \emph{tēnīcca}.) A spider? (\textbf{\ml{ചിലന്തി}}, \emph{cilanti}.) A bench? (\textbf{\ml{ബെഞ്ച്}}, \emph{beñcŭ}.) A shelf? (\textbf{\ml{ഷെൽഫ്}}, \emph{ṣelphŭ}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\ml{കർട്ടൻ}}, \emph{karṭṭan}.) An axe? (\textbf{\ml{കോടാലി}}, \emph{kōṭāli}.) A spade? (\textbf{\ml{മൺവെട്ടി}}, \emph{maṇveṭṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
